_doc: Hand weapons the crew carry (docs/CONTENT.md section 9); every entry has art in art/items/<art>.png. culture: concord, clans (the Scrapper clans; the art files call them 'scrap'), lumen, basalt, emberkin or fenn. class: pistol, rifle, heavy, melee or tool, which sets the arm pose. damage per hit, rate in uses per second, range in pixels. The class figures are pistol 10 / 1.5 / 300, rifle 14 / 2 / 500, heavy 30 / 0.6 / 350, melee 25 / 1.2 / 40 and tool 6 / 1 / 60; a culture may shift each by up to 20%, and `notes` says what changed and why. Crew carry their species' sidearm (data/species.json) drawn when idle in a fight, holstered at work; the numbers are for on-foot fights later.
